api_call.attack: Call it with a game, player or other ID that belongs to another account.
Call it with a key whose access in this area is below what the call needs.
Call it with a key limited to games that don't include this one.
Send a query or body field the call doesn't declare.
Send an input that does a higher access choice's work with a key that lacks it.
Repeat a call that should happen once (a publish, a restore, a vote) and look for a double effect.
Send two conflicting calls at the same moment and look for a state neither alone allows.
Put SQL, shell or path syntax in every text input and path part.
Call it on a game, version, key or account that was deleted.
Call it on a private, draft, held or taken-down game or version it shouldn't reach.
Call it about a guest player, who has no account.
Use it to reach or change what a 13 to 15 player's rules keep closed.
Use it to reach or change what a 16 or 17 player's rules keep closed.

api_call.case_name: A game on its own server
api_call.attack: Use it from or for a game that runs on the developer's own server, and look for more than Zaisma's rooms allow.
Read errors and next_steps for anything private: whether another account's thing exists, its IDs or its details.

mcp_tool.attack: Make the tool reach anything but the developer API calls it declares.

admin_tool.attack: Reach the tool without passing Cloudflare Access.
Reach it with a token alone, where Access is the real check.
Act on a report, game or precedent other than the one named.
Send an argument the tool doesn't declare.

page_form.attack: Submit the form from another site's page.
Submit it naming another account's thing.
Get a script to run through what the form takes or shows back.
Submit it with a forged, expired or another device's session.
Submit it when the account, game or link is in a state the form shouldn't act in.
Submit it many times fast, looking for a missing rate limit or lockout.

page_route.attack: Get a script to run on the page through anything it shows.
Open it signed out or as another account and look for anything private.
Check its answer for the security headers zaisma.com sends.
Open it with another account's ID in the address.
Walk IDs or names in the address to learn what exists.

game_file_address.attack: Open a private game's files without being let in.
Open a draft or unpublished version's files without its link.
Use ../, encoded slashes or odd paths to reach files outside the version.
Open a held, pending or taken-down game.

game_file_address.case_name: A tester link after it's off
game_file_address.attack: Keep playing through a tester link after it's turned off or ends.

game_file_address.case_name: A preview link after it's off
game_file_address.attack: Keep opening a preview after its links are ended or it expires.
Reach another game's file from this game's address.
Find a key or token left in an address, where logs and referrers keep it.

room_message.attack: Join or send with a forged, expired or another game's pass.
Reach a player who blocked you through this message.
Make the room think the message came from another player.
Read or change another room through this message.
Send fields the message doesn't take, or the wrong types.
Use the self-hosted game server's version of this message to reach more than Zaisma's rooms allow.

token_or_session.attack: Use it after it expires, is used up or is turned off.
Use one made for another game, app or issuer.
Use one account's on another account's things.
Find it in an address, a log, a referrer or a page another site can read.
